correctness.rationale: At the frozen actual 19c87a tree the final result concerns ordinary matchings of the 24-edge cuboctahedral graph L(Q3), not cube matchings. A 2648-face census yields (24,204,744,1116,528,32). A greedy matched Hasse graph on these faces is acyclic with 1287 pairs, critical counts 1 in degree 0, 65 in degree3 and 8 in degree4; an explicitly signed diagonal unit 8x8 Morse minor makes the eight attaching degree vectors primitive, so the Morse CW model is a wedge of 57 S3. With homology concentrated in degree3, χ3(g)=1−Σ_q(−1)^q tr(g|C_q); all 48 cube symmetries act via edge permutations and orientation signs. The 10-class character table has identity 57, central inversion 11 and S4×C2 Specht multiplicities ((1,2),(5,2),(5,4),(2,2),(2,1)); invariants G=1, rotations=3 follow from character averaging. Independently re-enumerated the 2648 nonempty faces and central inversion signed chain traces (0,−12,0,30,0,−8), yielding χ3(z)=11. Read all original verification scripts and Morse/character algorithms, but did not rerun the entire 48-element unit-minor certificate locally. Finite exhaustion is valid for this finite graph; no integral representation lattice or integral orbit-space claim.
